function.name: search_google
function.description: Performs a search query on Google and returns a list of URLs that match the search criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term to query on Google.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. The number must be a positive integer.

language.description: The language for the search results.

filter.description: A flag to filter explicit content in search results.

date_range.description: The date range for the search results in the format 'MM/DD/YYYY-MM/DD/YYYY'. If not specified, searches across all dates.

message.content:
Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most prominent vaccine manufacturers around the world (not exhaustive):

| Company | Headquarters | Notable Vaccines |
|---------|--------------|------------------|
| **Pfizer** | USA | COVID‑19 (Comirnaty), HPV, Hepatitis B |
| **Moderna** | USA | COVID‑19 (mRNA‑1273) |
| **Johnson & Johnson** | USA | COVID‑19 (Ad26.COV2.S), HPV, Hepatitis A |
| **AstraZeneca** | UK/Sweden | COVID‑19 (AZD1222), HPV, Influenza |
| **Novavax** | USA | COVID‑19 (NVX-CoV2373), Influenza |
| **Sanofi Pasteur** | France | Flu vaccines, Polio, Typhoid |
| **GlaxoSmithKline (GSK)** | UK | HPV, Pneumococcal, Rotavirus |
| **Merck & Co.** | USA | HPV, Meningitis, Influenza |
| **Bharat Biotech** | India | COVID‑19 (Covaxin), Hepatitis B |
| **Sinovac Biotech** | China | COVID‑19 (CoronaVac), Influenza |
| **Sinopharm** | China | COVID‑19 (BBIBP-CorV), Influenza |
| **CureVac** | Germany | mRNA vaccine platform (COVID‑19 trials) |
| **BioNTech** | Germany | COVID‑19 (mRNA‑1273) – partnered with Pfizer |
| **Takeda Pharmaceutical** | Japan | Hepatitis B, Rotavirus |
| **Roche** | Switzerland | HPV, Hepatitis B |

If you’d like deeper insights—such as market share, R&D pipelines, or geographic focus—just let me know!
